slice: DRINKS scene — cocktail bars & speakeasies, whisky/gin bars, natural-wine bars, rooftop skyline bars, craft-beer breweries/taprooms, and third-wave specialty coffee. Namespaced SEPARATE from all other SOURCES_HCMC_*.json sets. Yelp/TripAdvisor/Google contribute 0 toward the source bar.

outlets.name: Asia's 50 Best Bars / 50 Best Discovery (World's 50 Best)
outlets.note: Lone-authority-OK for bars. HCMC 50 Best Discovery listings used for Nhau Nhau, Telephone Bar and The Alley.

outlets.name: Tatler Asia
outlets.note: Lone-authority-OK for bars (Tatler Best Vietnam bars). Firkin, Rabbit Hole, PK Maltroom and MAD Wine Bar carry Tatler Asia dining/best-bar coverage.

outlets.name: Asia Bars & Restaurants (asia-bars.com)
outlets.note: Regional bar/restaurant trade site; dedicated features on Firkin and Rabbit Hole.

outlets.name: Saigoneer
outlets.note: Leading English-language Saigon culture/food-drink outlet; dedicated features on The Gin House, East West and Winking Seal.

outlets.name: Vietcetera
outlets.note: Leading Vietnamese English-language media brand; dedicated bar, wine, craft-beer and coffee features.

outlets.name: The Dot Magazine (Saigon)
outlets.note: Saigon insider city guide; annual best cocktail-bar / best rooftop / best coffeeshop round-ups and taphouse features.

outlets.name: Southeast Asia Globe
outlets.note: Established regional current-affairs & culture magazine; feature on The Gin House and Saigon's gin revival.

outlets.name: City Nomads
outlets.note: Regional lifestyle/nightlife publication; HCMC best-bars guide (2 Lam Son).

outlets.name: Cathay Pacific — Inspiration (editorial)
outlets.note: Flag-carrier editorial travel guide; '10 best rooftop bars in HCMC'. Used with a second credible source for the rooftop picks.

outlets.name: Star Wine List
outlets.note: International wine-bar/restaurant guide; HCMC best-wine-bars listing (NOB, MAD).

outlets.name: Rusty Compass (Mark Bowyer)
outlets.note: Independent, ad-free Vietnam travel guide; Saigon coffee guide and Heart of Darkness review.

outlets.name: The City Lane
outlets.note: Established independent travel & food publication; detailed HCMC craft-beer guide and per-brewery reviews.

outlets.name: The Bureau Asia
outlets.note: Saigon-focused bar & drinks trade publication; Te Te taphouse and negroni/bar features.

outlets.name: Sprudge
outlets.note: The leading global specialty-coffee publication; authoritative for the HCMC coffee scene. Dedicated Build-Outs/spotlight pieces on Building Coffee / BEL.

outlets.name: TheSmartLocal Vietnam
outlets.note: Regional lifestyle/food media; dedicated feature on The Hummingbird Cafe & Roastery.

outlets.name: VnExpress International
outlets.note: Vietnam's largest online newspaper (English edition); heritage feature on Telephone Bar's 100-year-old phone booths.
